s.d: μέμφομαι [in LXX: Sir.11:7 41:7, 2Ma.2:7 * ;] to blame, find fault: absol., [[romans 9 19|Rom.9:19;]] with accusative, αὐτούς (WH, txt.; αὐτούς, Rec., WH, mg.; on rendering with αὐτούς see Westc., in l), [[hebrews 8 8|Heb.8:8.]]† (AS)
μεμψίμοιρος, -ον (μέμφομαι, + μοῖρα, fate, lot), complaining of one's fate, querulous: Ju 16 † (AS)
